data.summary: The HR department of Druckerei Beispiellahn GmbH asks Johanna Beispielacker to enter her vacation preferences for January to June 2027 into a list in the break room or employee portal, within 10 business days of the letter date (18 November 2026).
data.explanation: Your employer needs your vacation wishes for the first half of 2027 so they can plan shifts. Enter your preferred dates into the list in the break room or the employee portal by the deadline shown (calculated from 10 working days after the letter's date). If you miss it, shift planning may proceed without your input, so your preferred dates might not be considered. This is an internal planning request, not a legal deadline.
